archetype_description: Clean, grounded, and trustworthy. Base colors are warm whites and stone greys to represent the physical home, with sharp, crisp Cobalt blue accents for the 'clean/water' association, strictly avoiding banned teal/purple. E1 Strategy: Prioritize high-end hotel cleanliness vibes over cheap generic service vibes.

typography.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-bold tracking-tight text-stone-900 leading-tight
typography.h2: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-semibold tracking-tight text-stone-900

layout.spacing_scale: Generous (py-24 to py-32 for major sections)
layout.grid_strategy: Tetris grid for Services (md:grid-cols-12, varying spans). Asymmetrical bento box for 'Why Choose Us'.
layout.border_radius: rounded-2xl for major containers, rounded-full for buttons

surfaces.header: backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/90 border-b border-stone-200 shadow-sm sticky top-0 z-50
surfaces.cards: bg-white border border-stone-100 shadow-[0_8px_30px_rgb(0,0,0,0.04)] hover:shadow-[0_12px_40px_rgb(0,0,0,0.08)] transition-all duration-300

components.button_primary: bg-blue-600 text-white font-medium hover:bg-blue-700 transition-colors px-8 py-4 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components.button_secondary: bg-white text-stone-900 border border-stone-200 font-medium hover:bg-stone-50 transition-colors px-8 py-4 rounded-full flex items-center justify-center gap-2
components.whatsapp_float: fixed bottom-6 right-6 bg-[#25D366] text-white p-4 rounded-full shadow-2xl hover:bg-[#128C7E] transition-transform duration-300 z-50 flex items-center justify-center hover:scale-110
components.form_input: w-full bg-stone-50 border border-stone-200 rounded-xl px-4 py-3 text-stone-900 focus:ring-2 focus:ring-blue-600 focus:border-transparent outline-none transition-all placeholder:text-stone-400

hero_bg.description: Woman happily vacuuming a bright, modern room - use as hero background with bg-stone-900/40 overlay. Must be max-h-[80vh] on mobile.

service_commercial.description: Modern office setting for commercial cleaning

about_housekeeper.description: Female housekeeper smiling holding tools - use for 'Why Choose Us' section

sections_required: Header (Logo: Dekora Clean S.A.S, Navigation, Language Selector EN/ES)
Hero (Full width background image with overlay. Split content: Left is Headline/Value Prop, Right is Contact/Booking Form using Resend)
Stats (Grid of 3-4 metrics: 500+ Homes Cleaned, 100% Satisfaction, etc.)
Services Grid (Cards for Residential, Commercial, and Deep Cleaning)
Why Choose Us (Bento grid layout showcasing reliability, eco-friendly products, and trained staff, with the about_housekeeper image)
How It Works (1. Book, 2. We Clean, 3. Relax)
Testimonials (Colombian Spanish reviews with English translations visible via toggle or presented bilingually)
CTA (High impact section with solid blue background and large text prompting to book)
Footer (Contact info, address, business card details, social links)
technical_instructions: Template Adherence: The user provided a specific template design. Follow its structural flow exactly. Align components to match its layout logic (e.g. if form is in hero, keep it in hero).
Language Toggle: Implement a React state-based language switcher (EN/ES) in the Header. Ensure all hardcoded text responds to this toggle.
Form Integration: The contact form MUST be wired up to use Resend for email delivery.
WhatsApp Float: Render a fixed floating WhatsApp button bottom-right. The link MUST be https://wa.me/573044072499 (includes +57 for Colombia).
Testing: Apply `data-testid` to all interactive elements, e.g., `data-testid='language-toggle'`, `data-testid='hero-contact-submit'`.
Components: Use Shadcn UI for Form, Accordion (FAQ), and Select (Language Toggle). heavily customize them to remove standard 'Vercel' look and match the specified theme.
Fonts: Import 'Outfit' and 'Work Sans' from Google Fonts in index.css. Do NOT use Inter for headings.
